user.title: Unsplashed
user.description: Saves fresh Unsplash photos to a folder on a schedule. Create a free app at {apps_url} and paste its **Access Key** below. You'll choose what to fetch on the next screen.

data_description.access_key: From your Unsplash developer app. Not the secret key.

reauth_confirm.title: New Unsplash access key
reauth_confirm.description: Unsplash rejected the saved access key. Paste a current one.

feed.title: What to fetch
feed.description: Use search words, topics/collections, or photographers. Color works with search words or collections. Leave everything empty for random photos from all of Unsplash.

data_description.query: Comma-separated keywords, for example: maine, coast, autumn forest.
data_description.topics: Pick from Unsplash's featured topics, or type any topic slug.
data_description.count: Each fetch uses 1 API request plus 1 per photo. Demo apps get 50 requests per hour.
data_description.width: Photos are cropped to exactly this size. Width smaller than height gives portrait photos.
data_description.folder: Absolute path. Point an Album Slideshow "Local folder" entry here.
data_description.strict_content_filter: Ask Unsplash to filter more aggressively for family-friendly content.
data_description.usernames: Comma-separated Unsplash usernames (up to 10), for example: chrislawton, @nasa. Photos come only from these photographers. Can't be combined with other filters.
data_description.color: Only photos dominated by this color. Uses Unsplash search, so it works with search words or collections but not topics. With no search words, the color name is used as the search.
data_description.include_illustrations: Unsplash now mixes illustrations into photo results. Leave off to keep the feed to photos.

error.folder_not_absolute: Use an absolute path such as /media/wallpapers.
error.folder_not_writable: Home Assistant can't create or write to that folder.
error.query_and_topics: Unsplash can't combine search words with topics or collections. Use one or the other.
error.usernames_exclusive: Photographers can't be combined with search words, topics, collections or a color. Clear the others or the photographers.
error.color_and_topics: Unsplash's color filter only works with search words or collections, not topics.
